Default System Table Mode is ACPI; select Device Tree in Device Manager > Raspberry Pi Configuration > ACPI / Device Tree > System Table Mode, otherwise the probe sees no FDT table.
Upstream reports tested on BCM2712 C1 boards; D0 boards may need a newer EEPROM and carry a display risk.
Upstream reports RP1 USB, display, PCIe, SD and RNG working; RP1 Ethernet and EEPROM NVRAM not working.
